title: WWE Confirms New June RAW Dates for Roman Reigns After Schedule Changes
summary: Roman Reigns is officially back on WWE’s upcoming schedule after weeks of uncertainty surrounding his June appearances. After previously being pulled from all advertised June appearances due to not being factored into WWE’s Night of Champions plans in Saudi Arabia, WWE has now reversed course and started locking in new dates for Reigns moving forward. On May 11, 2026, WWE took to Twitter and officially announced that Reigns will appear on multiple upcoming episodes of WWE Raw. According to WWE’s announcement, Reigns is now scheduled for the June 1, June 15, and June 29 editions of RAW. This is significant because it marks a major shift from the earlier direction surrounding Reigns’ status. Prior reports indicated he had been removed from June television entirely after creative plans tied to Night of Champions changed behind the scenes. At the time, the belief was that since Reigns was not scheduled for the Saudi Arabia event, WWE no longer needed him involved in weekly television leading into the show. Now, that clearly appears to have changed. The company is not only advertising Reigns again, but specifically promoting him for multiple RAW appearances throughout June — a sign that WWE has finalized a new direction following the fallout from Backlash. This also supports previous reports that WWE was waiting to make final decisions regarding Reigns’ summer schedule until after Backlash wrapped up. Once that event concluded, the company seemingly locked in its next phase involving “The Tribal Chief.” At this point, WWE hasn’t revealed exactly what role Reigns will play during those appearances or whether he’s heading directly into another major feud. But after weeks of uncertainty surrounding his status, fans now officially know when he’ll be back on television. Bottom line — Roman Reigns’ June WWE schedule is back on track, and WWE is once again building around one of its biggest stars heading into the summer. What do you think WWE’s next big storyline for Roman Reigns should be? Drop your thoughts below.

title: Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods Book First Major Appearances After WWE Exit
summary: Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods are already lining up appearances outside WWE following their shocking departure from the company. According to PWInsiderElite.com, the former The New Day members have officially signed on for the next two scheduled GalaxyCon pop culture conventions. PWInsider reported that Kingston and Woods are set to appear in Oklahoma City and Nashville, Tennessee during the weekends of May 24 and May 30. "PWInsiderElite.com has confirmed that Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods have signed to appear at the next two scheduled Galaxycon pop culture conventions. The former WWE stars will be appearing in Oklahoma City and Nashville, TN the weekends of 5/24 and 5/30, we are told." This update marks the first confirmed public appearances for the duo since news broke that they had parted ways with WWE after rejecting restructured TKO-era contracts. That situation quickly became one of the biggest wrestling stories of the year after reports revealed WWE had approached both men about accepting reduced deals despite the pair only signing fresh five-year contracts in 2025. According to Dave Meltzer in the Wrestling Observer Newsletter, WWE internally viewed Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods as talents without major long-term creative plans moving forward. “The New Day, Kofi Kingston & Xavier Woods, who were on the list of those without significant future plans…” Meltzer then explained that WWE gave them the choice of accepting reduced money and transitioning into smaller roles or leaving the company entirely. “Were essentially put in the position where they were going to be cut, but were offered less money to stay with WWE.” The report also stated WWE’s long-term vision for Kingston and Woods involved gradually reducing their in-ring responsibilities while shifting them into more promotional work for the company. “Wind down their in-ring careers and finish their current contract doing some in-ring and working in a promotional capacity. They both decided to leave the promotion.” Bryan Alvarez later added more context by explaining that Kingston and Woods were specifically asked to move into new TKO-structured deals before deciding to walk away. “They were asked to restructure to TKO deals, they didn’t like the deals, so they were then granted their release.” Since their departures became public, speculation surrounding a potential AEW move has exploded — especially given the longtime teasing between The New Day and The Young Bucks. PWInsider previously reported there is already major excitement internally within AEW about the possibility of bringing Kingston and Woods into the company. “There is a lot of excitement in AEW circles about the potential of The New Day coming into the company.” Bottom line — Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods may be gone from WWE, but they’re already stepping back into the spotlight almost immediately, and the speculation surrounding what comes next for The New Day is only getting louder. Do you think Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods are ultimately headed to AEW, or could they surprise everyone with a completely different next move? Leave your thoughts and feedback below.

title: Asuka Passes The Torch To IYO Sky During 5/11 WWE RAW
summary: The May 11 episode of WWE RAW was an important show, as it featured the aftermath of Backlash. Many people have been talking about Asuka’s semi-retirement. This week on RAW, they approached that subject head-on. Asuka showed up in a backstage segment this week on RAW. She had a moment with IYO Sky, where they spoke primarily in Japanese. Then, Asuka made it clear that she was passing the torch. The Empress of Tomorrow said that she was so happy to have IYO Sky beat her at Backlash. She said that she was waiting for someone to take her place. After saying how proud she is of IYO, they hugged. IYO Sky said goodbye, and then Asuka said that she would see her later. After that, IYO Sky watched as Asuka walked off. The camera let fans watch Asuka leave through the door, as she wheeled her suitcase behind her. Later on, Michael Cole addressed Asuka’s current status. He said that her current status is “up in the air.” Only time will tell if she returns, and when. We will have to see what is next for Asuka. At this point, it seems that she will enjoy her semi-retirement, and she is bidding WWE farewell for now. What’s your take on Asuka taking off like this? Do you believe that she will be back? Let us know what you think in the comments section!
